<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that breaks an aryl halide bond and forms a ketone, which corresponds to the Friedel‑Crafts acylation of an aromatic ring.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC(=O)c1ccccc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aryl halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ketones"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
